title: M365 Power BI Dashboard
tagline: Power BI dashboard to steer Microsoft 365 usage, licences and risks.
description: I built a Power BI dashboard to track Microsoft 365 users, activity and licences. I collect data through Microsoft Graph and organise it to support account cleanup and cost monitoring.
features: Overview with global KPIs on accounts, licences and M365 activity
Licence analysis with available stock, over-allocation, critical alerts and risk level
User segmentation between active, inactive, never signed in, technical accounts and disabled accounts
User detail drillthrough page with a 360 profile, key dates, usage score and assigned licences
DAX measures to track application adoption across Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and OneNote
Business tooltips and UX banners to put indicators in context and prioritise clean-up actions
challenges: I corrected missing values and double counting in the model. I also distinguished Azure AD sign-ins from actual Microsoft 365 service usage.
learnings: I deepened my knowledge of Microsoft Graph, Power Query and DAX. This work taught me to prioritise reliable, easy-to-read indicators.
